query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus = 'pending' AND briefData IS NOT NULL AND briefData != '' AND salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND salesApproachData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enrich_only_issue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL AND briefData IS NOT NULL AND briefData != '' AND salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND salesApproachData != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fitscore_only_issue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as truly_missing_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as truly_missing_sales
FROM companies WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003);
